taken.name: Command palette
taken.about:
It is a pop-up search box for finding and running any action in the app by typing part of its name, so you don't have to hunt through menus.
It opens with Ctrl+Shift+P, and it floats near the top of the window over everything else.
As you type, the list below narrows to matching commands, and a small badge shows how many results match (here 3) and how many are selected.
You move through the list with the arrow keys or the mouse, and each row shows the command name with its keyboard shortcut. Pressing Enter or clicking runs the highlighted one.
It closes when you run a command, press Escape, or click outside it.
